visualCharacteristics: Grid of promotional travel-deal cards (1 column mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px). Each card: top image with an optional eyebrow badge overlaid top-left, then a body with title, description, a 'Save up to' savings block, and an actions row (Book now button + Learn more link).
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = image cell + body cell. Body holds an optional short badge paragraph (promoted onto the image), title, description text, a paragraph beginning 'Save', and one or more CTA link paragraphs.
usage: Rows of promotional deal cards grouped by theme (Featured, Partner hotels/cars, North America, International, Cruises, Luxury).
